rationale: Motor vehicle collision with severe vehicle damage and bodily injury (whiplash and sprained wrist) caused by another driver's rear-end impact at a red light.
claim_summary: High-severity auto collision claim: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended on Route 9 at approximately 8:15am yesterday. Other driver struck at ~35 mph with no braking, totaling vehicle with severe trunk/back-seat damage. Claimant injured with whiplash and sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information. Full auto coverage active with $750 deductible and $100k limit. Requires damage assessment, vehicle valuation, and injury evaluation.

case_facts.description: Rear-ended by other driver traveling approximately 35 mph with no braking; entire trunk crushed into back seat; vehicle totaled
case_facts.injury_party: Claimant sustained whiplash and sprained wrist
case_facts.police_report: Police report filed; other driver's insurance information on report
